title: CoverStory local application assembly: Days 57–70
status_semantics: Contracts are plans. Scaffold, learner implementation, integration and actual completion are independent states. Only recorded learner evidence can advance learner status.
scope: A loopback-only, passwordless synthetic local runtime for existing policy issuance/readback and read-only renewal preview. The local DB is disposable. No new product feature, no StreamForge, no real data, and no changes to Days 1–56 contracts. PostgreSQL 18.6 is selected for the disposable test harness. No existing user database is upgraded.
postgresql_target_decision: PostgreSQL 18.6 selected for the disposable embedded test harness after official support and platform-artifact checks; see docs/reboot/continuation-57-70/postgresql-options.md
